title: Add risk-tiered AI evaluation and use-case classification
requirements:
- Define evaluation as layered (technical, clinical, human factors, security, real-world monitoring) and use plain terminology in place of 'evals'
- Classify use cases by autonomy, reversibility, consequence of error and oversight needed
- Clarify that trustworthiness is demonstrated through evidence and governance, and that trust should not be demanded as a substitute
- Make evaluation risk-tiered, with reusable protocols and shared regional capacity for smaller systems
- Expand decision-maker questions (non-AI alternatives, subgroup performance, exit) and supplier documentation duties
- Address integrity of the evaluation environment itself
